body.objective: Generalize the closed-S3 nonhomogeneous relative-phase result to an arbitrary connected closed oriented Cauchy three-manifold, separating universal compact-Gauss reduction from topology-dependent harmonic one-forms, Wilson sectors and Laplace eigenspaces.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal closed-S3 nonhomogeneous Hodge/Gauss preflight and identify exactly which steps use the round-S3 spectrum rather than only compactness, orientation and Hodge theory.  For a finite rank compact Abelian gauge group acting on finitely many complex clock fields with an integral charge matrix and positive or explicitly stratified two-derivative kinetic form, formulate the linearized phase/connection complex on a general connected closed oriented Riemannian three-manifold.  Use Hodge decomposition to derive the integrated and modewise Gauss constraints, quotient exact gauge directions, retain harmonic one-form/Wilson sectors with their integral lattice, and prove the dimension and reduced kinetic/gradient forms of gauge-invariant relative phases in terms of charge rank, Betti numbers and Laplace eigenspace multiplicities.  State necessary and sufficient conditions for positive hyperbolic nonzero modes and separately classify zero modes, reducibility and disconnected charge strata.  Reproduce the S3 theorem when b1=0 and the certified homogeneous theorem at the constant scalar mode.  Emit a presentation-independent theorem payload and an independent verifier using at least one b1>0 exact fixture.  End with a structural theorem, a precisely scoped topological obstruction, or UNDECIDED with the missing analytic hypothesis named.
body.current_gate: general closed-Cauchy relative-phase Hodge/Gauss structure theorem
body.forbid: no arbitrary-manifold theorem inferred from S3 samples; no Hodge decomposition used without declared regularity and compact boundaryless hypotheses; no harmonic one-form erased as pure gauge; no rational charge quotient substituted for the integral compact-gauge lattice; no positive modewise symbol promoted to a global Green-hyperbolic or nonlinear theorem; no D-gauge, gravity, Hadamard, particle, scale-generation or quantum claim
activates: a topology-sensitive relative-clock atlas and a candidate local-to-global causal-parent theorem
body.resource_hint: STRUCTURAL TOPOLOGICAL GENERALIZATION.  Keep analytic Hodge facts as declared hypotheses, but certify all finite charge-lattice, harmonic-sector and reduced-form statements exactly.  Use the integral filtered-complex and sheaf/local-to-global Forge requests rather than silently rationalizing global sectors.
notes: This is intentionally sequenced after the S3 field-mode theorem.  It turns a model-universe clock mechanism into a background-class statement while retaining topology as data rather than assuming it away.
